notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.
